xmldoc.short_description: Create text or numeric edit field.

description.p: ef = uieditfield creates a text edit field; uieditfield(parent, 'numeric') creates a numeric edit field. Text style: Value (char), CharacterLimits, InputType, ValueChangingFcn. Numeric style: Value (double), Limits, LowerLimitInclusive/UpperLimitInclusive, RoundFractionalValues, ValueDisplayFormat, AllowEmpty. Both: Editable, HorizontalAlignment, Placeholder, ValueChangedFcn.
